taxes.dated: constitution: lexifina repository text (pass 12); asset-tax texts fetched 2026-11-21 (pass 15)
taxes.why: Not levied (convention R5-3k-G, pass 15): Constitución art. 74: "Los tributos se crean, modifican o derogan, o se establece una exoneración, exclusivamente por ley o decreto legislativo" (`pe/law/const_art-074.md`). The Impuesto Temporal a los Activos Netos (Ley 28424, Congreso text `pe/law/congreso_ley28424_itan.*`, OCR) falls on the net assets of third-category (business) income earners in the general regime (arts. 1, 2, 4), and the amount paid is a credit against the income tax's monthly advance payments and the annual settlement, refundable on a loss (art. 8): an advance income tax on businesses (heading 1200), not a tax on net wealth. Its term was extended to 2007 by Ley 28929 art. 8 (`pe/law/congreso_ley28929.*`) and D.Leg. 976 (`pe/law/congreso_dleg976.*`) set 0.4 % above S/ 1,000,000 from 2009; the later law keeping it in force and any later wording of art. 8 were not read: whichever reading holds in 2025, no tax on net wealth is levied. No law read in this build levies a recurrent tax on net wealth (laws read include: TUO Ley del IGV e ISC art. 17, Apéndices I-II; TUO Ley del IGV e ISC Título II; TUO LIR art. 55 (29,5 %); TUO LIR art. 56 a), d), e), f); 1.x model (see its summary.json); LIR TUO arts. 2, 21.1, 36, 52-A).
